text: The story search in ShortsOS was moved from expecting three to seven strong stories to a rule of zero to three, where zero is a distinct, honest outcome. Technical failures, unfinished analysis and runs paused for budget stay separate outcomes, so a failure is not reported as a weak story. Two related fixes followed the same logic: filming dates are no longer guessed from file dates, and duplicate checks no longer look across clients.
